verdict.rationale: Cline documents multiple programmatic surfaces — a scriptable CLI with headless mode and processable output (cline-docs-3, cline-docs-32), cron-scheduled agents (cline-docs-23), and the ACP protocol letting any ACP-capable client drive Cline as a coding agent (cline-docs-7, cline-docs-26) — which together let an AI-native user drive it programmatically. However, an explicit probe for a formal public REST/OpenAPI API found nothing (cline-probe-3: all candidate openapi/swagger paths 404), so there's no conventional documented public API, only CLI/ACP surfaces. Missing for 10: a formal REST/HTTP API with OpenAPI/swagger docs or SDK reference, and independent hands-on confirmation of scripting the CLI/ACP end-to-end.
